svg.text: 10 firms in 5 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 374 firms, 1,445 interlocks, 6 components (largest 364). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 107 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
